report.summary: Checkout 5xx errors began at 14:00:00Z, about four minutes after the checkout-service v2.14.0 deploy at 13:56:00Z. The checkout-service logs show a NullPointerException in DiscountEngine.apply (line 88) on nearly every failing request, and api-gateway reports 500s from checkout-service for POST /api/v1/checkout. Checkout errors went from about 0.3% to about 18%, and api-gateway 5xx went from about 0.4% to about 6%, which matches the alert. Dependencies (payment, inventory, auth) are healthy and show no correlated change, so the regression is most likely the new discount engine code in v2.14.0. A past incident (P04) had the same signature after a pricing deploy and was fixed by rollback. Rollback of v2.14.0 is the leading mitigation.

root_cause.mechanism: The v2.14.0 discount engine throws a NullPointerException in DiscountEngine.apply for some carts. Checkout POSTs return 500, and api-gateway passes them through as 5xx.
assumptions: Health checks are shallow and do not exercise the discount path.
No other change explains the NPE.

ranked_hypotheses.mechanism: The v2.14.0 discount engine throws a NullPointerException in DiscountEngine.apply for some carts. Checkout POSTs return 500, and api-gateway passes them through as 5xx.
assumptions: Health checks are shallow and do not exercise the discount path.
No other change explains the NPE.

ranked_hypotheses.mechanism: An expired TLS certificate on payment-service causes handshake failures and checkout 5xx, as in past incident P06.
assumptions: The same symptom pattern would appear in the checkout logs.

ranked_hypotheses.mechanism: A traffic surge or gateway saturation drives 5xx rates.

observed_facts.statement: api-gateway 5xx (error_rate) rose from about 0.4% at 13:55:00Z to 6.06% at 14:00:00Z and stayed between 5.8% and 6.6% through 14:30:00Z.
checkout-service error_rate jumped from 0.35% at 13:55:00Z to 17.76% at 14:00:00Z, peaking at 19.5% at 14:25:00Z.
checkout-service latency_p99 rose from about 325 ms before 14:00 to about 397-425 ms from 14:00 onward; checkout request_rate stayed roughly flat (82-88 req/s).
Deploy v2.14.0 to checkout-service (new discount engine replacing legacy pricing rules) completed at 13:56:00Z.
checkout-service logged 40 ERROR lines of NullPointerException at DiscountEngine.apply(DiscountEngine.java:88), the first at 14:00:27Z, with distinct cart_ids.
api-gateway logged repeated 'upstream checkout-service returned 500 for POST /api/v1/checkout' errors from 14:00:08Z onward.
api-gateway and checkout-service CPU and memory stayed in normal ranges (about 37-39% and 55-60%) throughout the window.
Health checks for api-gateway, checkout-service, auth-service, inventory-service, notification-queue and payment-service all returned HTTP 200 at 14:28:00Z.
A past incident P04 (2026-05-12) recorded checkout 5xx from an unhandled null field in new pricing code, resolved by rollback.

assumptions: The health checks are shallow and do not exercise the checkout POST path or discount logic, so their 200s do not rule out the regression.
DiscountEngine.java line 88 belongs to the v2.14.0 change and not to older code.
The telemetry window is complete, and no other deploy hit a dependency in the minutes before 14:00.
The discount-engine is not a separate monitored service; it runs inside checkout-service.

inferred_conclusions.statement: The v2.14.0 discount engine deploy in checkout-service is the most likely origin: it was completed 4 minutes before onset, and its NPE accounts for nearly all checkout 500s, which propagate to api-gateway as 5xx.
Rolling back checkout-service to v2.14.0's predecessor should restore checkout conversion and bring the 5xx rate back to baseline.
Traffic surge, resource exhaustion at the gateway, and dependency failures are unlikely: request rate was flat and CPU/memory and dependency health were normal.

remediation.action: Roll back checkout-service from v2.14.0 to the previous release, or disable the new discount engine via its feature path if one exists.
remediation.rationale: The NPE started four minutes after the deploy and accounts for nearly all checkout 500s.

remediation.action: Verify recovery: checkout error_rate and api-gateway 5xx return to about 0.3-0.4% and conversion recovers.
remediation.rationale: Confirms the rollback addressed the cause.

remediation.action: Fix the null handling in DiscountEngine.apply (line 88) for carts with missing discount/coupon fields, and add a regression test.
remediation.rationale: Removes the root defect before re-release.

remediation.action: Make the health check exercise the checkout POST path with discount logic, so a shallow 200 cannot mask 500s.
remediation.rationale: Health checks currently reported healthy during a 19% checkout error rate.

remediation.action: Add a canary or progressive rollout with an alert on checkout error_rate after deploys.
remediation.rationale: A 4-minute detection gap plus a full rollout caused a P1; the prior pricing incident P04 shows this failure class recurs.

open_questions: Which carts trigger the NPE (for example, missing coupon field or legacy pricing data), and is the fraction of affected carts consistent with the 18% error rate?
Was there any config or feature-flag change alongside v2.14.0? None appears in the change history, but the search covered only telemetry-era records.
Why does the checkout error rate (18%) exceed what the gateway shows (6%) and is some of the gap a client retry or 499 effect?
Is the checkout conversion drop of 40% fully explained by the 5xx rate, or does the discount logic also affect cart totals?
